comparison.objective: Open a stepladder until its spreader locks; candidate sets a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deployment of large hinged sections and latch engagement versus precision screw/nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Ladder fully open, spreader locked, and feet down versus target opening locked and repeatable.
comparison.reason: Both end in a locked mechanism, but they test different manipulation and retention mechanisms.
